title: Exclusive / AI nonprofit will spend $10 million on journalism
key_facts: Tarbell Center for AI Journalism pledges $10 million by end of 2027 for AI coverage.
First grant: $480,000 to NPR's new video podcast Machine Gods, from former Hard Fork hosts Kevin Roose and Casey Newton.
Separate $250,000 to NPR's Power and Influence desk.
Previous commitments totaled $400,000 over four years; new grants $50,000 to $500,000, possibly more.
Backed by groups including Coefficient Giving; criticised by some in the AI industry and on the political right as fuelling exaggerated safety fears.
Tarbell says it has editorial firewalls and discloses donors over $10,000; Semafor found no instance of interference.
quote_evidence: Semafor has not found instances where Tarbell interfered directly in any stories.
"Their funding has been very useful in helping us get started," Roose said.
why_it_matters_hint: Large new funding for AI reporting, from a group close to the AI safety movement.
